{{Top|leg}}
'''GNR-0''' was a location known as the sacred "[[Droid/Legends|droid]] graveyard" during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Built into a heavy metal [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], it was the place where many artificial beings came to [[Death/Legends|die]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Where Droids Go to Die}}</ref>

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1stm}}
